item.dc:creator: tedsanders
item.description:

The piece explains why the question is so difficult, what solving it would mean for math and physics, and how researchers brandish partial results and new techniques in attempts to crack it. The prize carries a $1 million award from the Clay Mathematics Institute, underscoring the problem’s prestige and impact.
